credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Vertical extreme close-up pastel of the delicate inner folds of an iris flower.  Palette of subtle grey-purples.  Mostly abstract rendition of iris petals closing in on one another, with the darkest area in the lower right corner.
